answer: New identities start in a nebula, an unverified cluster. To leave it, one needs five attestations from diverse, established, non-kin counterparties. Each attestation is a single-use signal of a transaction, and each counterparty has one slot per epoch. If diversity falls to its nadir, standing freezes and the deposit is slashed. A farm making N fakes pays N times five attestations plus N deposits; an honest identity pays once and earns undiluted.
